answer: Validators lock 1,200 ETH and face a quadratic slashing curve that erodes 1.5% of stake per equivocation, turning any Sybil set into a capital sink. The marginal attack cost therefore grows super-linearly, so a 10-node coalition must spend 100-fold the single-node bond while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay caps the extraction horizon to one pulse, yielding negative expected utility. Consequently the security threshold exceeds the maximal extractable tide, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
